run: hyprctl monitors all -j | jq -e '([.[] | select(.name == "Virtual-1")] | length == 1) and ([.[] | select(.name == "Virtual-2")] | length == 1)'
setsid -f kitty --title 'Hornero QA Critical Window' sleep 600 >/tmp/hornero-qa-critical-window.log 2>&1

for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
  [ "$(hyprctl clients -j | jq '[.[] | select(.title == "Hornero QA Critical Window")] | length')" = 1 ] && exit 0
  sleep 0.5
done
exit 1

jq -n --argjson monitors "$(hyprctl monitors -j)" --argjson clients "$(hyprctl clients -j)" '[$monitors[] | {monitor: .id, workspace: .activeWorkspace.id}] as $active | [$clients[] as $client | select($client.title == "Hornero QA Critical Window" and $client.monitor == ($monitors[] | select(.name == "Virtual-2") | .id) and $client.mapped == true and ($client.hidden // false) == false) | select(any($active[]; .monitor == $client.monitor and .workspace == $client.workspace.id))] | length' | grep -qx 1
hyprctl keyword bind 'CTRL ALT, Z, exec, sh /tmp/hornero-qa-display-off'
hyprctl keyword bind 'CTRL ALT, X, exec, sh /tmp/hornero-qa-display-on'

jq -n --argjson monitors "$(hyprctl monitors -j)" --argjson clients "$(hyprctl clients -j)" '[$monitors[] | .id] as $active_monitors | [$clients[] as $client | select($client.title == "Hornero QA Critical Window" and $client.mapped == true and ($active_monitors | index($client.monitor) != null))] | length'

jq -n --argjson monitors "$(hyprctl monitors -j)" --argjson workspaces "$(hyprctl workspaces -j)" --argjson clients "$(hyprctl clients -j)" '{monitors: [$monitors[] | {id, name, activeWorkspace}], workspaces: [$workspaces[] | {id, name, monitor, windows}], critical_window: [$clients[] | select(.title == "Hornero QA Critical Window") | {address, mapped, hidden, monitor, workspace}]}'
